title: Logical Access Security & Perimeter Controls
requirement: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events to meet its commitments and system requirements.

title: User Registration, Authentication & MFA
requirement: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users whose access is administered by the entity. Multi-factor authentication is required for all administrative access.

title: Access Modification & Timely Deprovisioning
requirement: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data, software, functions, and other protected information assets based on changes in job responsibilities or termination of employment. Revocation must occur promptly upon departure.

title: Logical Boundary & Network Protections
requirement: The entity implements logical boundaries to protect protected information assets from other systems and entities, including firewalls, segmentation, and bastion jump hosts.

title: Encryption in Transit and at Rest
requirement: The entity protects data in transit over public networks and untrusted networks, and data stored at rest using robust encryption mechanisms (e.g. AES-256, TLS 1.3).

title: Vulnerability Management & Scanning
requirement: To meet its commitments and system requirements, the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations and new vulnerabilities across systems.

title: Security Incident Detection & Triage
requirement: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors affecting the entity's ability to meet its commitments.

title: Incident Containment & Response Procedures
requirement: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could impact the entity's ability to meet its commitments and system requirements, and executes defined containment, eradication, and post-mortem procedures.

title: Incident Notification Timelines
requirement: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program, including notification to affected internal and external parties within required contractual and legal timeframes.

title: Change Management & Code Review
requirement: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its commitments and system requirements.
